2026-11-25b-nusuk-chat-badge.json.name: NusukChat 2.9.1: Badge
2026-11-25b-nusuk-chat-badge.json.source: The DL Advisor's change to 💬 Chat UI on 25 November 2026: a new local Badge set (Color × Status) placed first in the _Chat Container Body.

added.what: 50 × 50. success: rosette + tick-02 24 at 13,13; failure: rounded triangle (48 × 42 at 1,4) + unavailable 20 at 15,22; alert: hexagon (43.3 × 49.4 at 3.65,0.3) + alert-02 38 at 6,6. light: Alerts/Surface/Success · Error · Warning with Alerts/Icons/*; dark: Alerts/Surface/Solid * with Alerts/Icons/White.

changed.change: badge prop: first in the bubble at the start edge.

openDL: Figma: rename the solid variants to Color=Dark (they duplicate Color=Light, Status=Faliure / Alert), and Faliure → Failure.
Figma: alert-02 is 38 inside a 43 hexagon; 24 would match the other badges.
Figma: add a Show Badge boolean on _Chat Container; today the layer is shown or hidden by hand.

native.ios: A 50 × 50 ZStack: the shape as a Path filled with the Alerts surface token, the DL icon on top at the Figma offset; accessibilityLabel from the status.
native.android: Box(Modifier.size(50.dp)) { Icon(shape vector, tint = Alerts surface); Icon(DL icon, tint = Alerts icon or White) }; contentDescription from the status.

2026-11-25-nusuk-chat-mixed-loading-taba.name: NusukChat 2.9.0: Mixed messages, Loading Text, tab bar actions
2026-11-25-nusuk-chat-mixed-loading-taba.source: The DL Advisor's major update to 💬 Chat UI, 25 November 2026: _Chat Container Master (8 states), AI Chat Messages (37 variants), AI Tab Bar (8 statuses, light and dark master).

added.what: Nusuk: Body › Upper Footer (time + copy/up/down) › Content No BG with DL CTA Primary SM, Icon=No Icon, wrap 8 × 8, start edge. User: Body › Content No BG › Lower Footer (time).
Actions Only: Regular/Body/Two with 18 inline padding, 12 above one non-wrapping row of CTA Primary SM, no icon, gap 8; the row scrolls sideways.

changed.change: New below prop (Mixed). The footer is the Upper Footer between bubble and below for Nusuk, the Lower Footer last for user.

DL Loading Text (80700:13922) replaces the fading dots: 23 × 13, dots 3.66 on a 9 pitch, the active dot scales ×1.6, 150 ms a step, ease-out, from the start edge. AI Chat Messages Style=Loading: Nusuk 80835:33952, User 80392:4524.
User text is 80835:30455; 80392:4524 now holds User / Loading.
Master is now _AI Tab Bar Master with Darkmode=Off (80392:4168) and On (80821:21830); Status=Default shows the home indicator only.
Adds earth, global and mail-01 from Figma (not in the DL icon set). NationalitySearch uses global from here; it rendered blank before.

openDL: earth, global and mail-01 are used by the chat but missing from the DL icon set: request them for 🎨 Icons.
Loading Text is a remote library component: confirm it is published in the DL and named for code (LoadingDots?).

native.ios: Mixed: VStack(spacing 12) { bubble; HStack { time; Spacer; actions } (Nusuk); FlowLayout(spacing 8) of the DL primary .small buttons }. Loading: three 3.66 circles, scaleEffect 1.6 on the active one, 0.15 s steps, easeOut, honouring accessibilityReduceMotion. Tab bar actions: ScrollView(.horizontal, showsIndicators: false) of .small primary buttons, spacing 8, 18 leading/trailing content margins.
native.android: Mixed: Column(spacedBy(12.dp)) { bubble; Row { time; Spacer; actions } (Nusuk); FlowRow(spacedBy(8.dp), spacedBy(8.dp)) of PrimaryButton(size = Sm) }. Loading: three 3.66.dp circles, scale 1.6 on the active one, 150 ms steps, FastOutSlowIn/EaseOut, off when animations are disabled. Tab bar actions: LazyRow(horizontalArrangement = spacedBy(8.dp), contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 18.dp)).

breaking: NusukChat.Text user figma node changed to 80835:30455.
Loading no longer fades; it scales one dot at a time (respects reduced motion).

DL Alerts Type=Error (alert-02) at full width, 18 above the actions; actions are CTA Primary XS, Icon=Right, arrow-right-02, same wrap, 12 below.

openDL: DL Chip proposal for chat answers is withdrawn: Chips is now proposed as a use of DL Button, not a Chip variant.

native.ios: Follow-ups: a wrapping flow (spacing 8, line spacing 8) of the DL primary button at .small (38) or .xSmall (26 for Error) with a trailing arrow.right that flips with layoutDirection; 12 bottom padding.
native.android: Follow-ups: FlowRow(horizontalArrangement = spacedBy(8.dp), verticalArrangement = spacedBy(8.dp)) of DL PrimaryButton(size = Sm or Xs, trailingIcon = arrow_right_02, autoMirrored = true); padding(bottom = 12.dp).

breaking: Chips and ErrorMsg render DL Buttons by default; pass chip: true for the old chip. The buttons prop is removed (it is now the default).
Chip clicks no longer set aria-pressed; selection state is the flow's job.

2026-11-18-nusuk-chat-container-states.j.name: NusukChat 2.8.6: the six _Chat Container Master states, as Figma draws them
2026-11-18-nusuk-chat-container-states.j.source: The DL Advisor's walkthrough of _Chat Container Master (80451:18766) on 18 November 2026.

states.Status=Chat, Type=Nusuk/BG (80451:18764): Nusuk owns the message or question and the user has not answered yet. 24×27 bot at the start, aligned to the top of the bubble, 12 apart; Body radius Radius/MD with Radius/XS at the top-start corner (next to the bot); footer: time at the start, Actions (copy, helpful, not helpful) at the end when shown.
states.Status=Chat, Type=User/BG (80451:18765): The user has answered. The question moves to the top as a header row (the 12×14 Nusuk mark without eyes, then the question in Notes 14 Regular, text-heading, 12 apart, at the start); 18 below it the answer bubble with the 24 user avatar at the end, aligned to the bottom; Radius/XS at the bottom-end corner; time at the end, beside the avatar.
states.Status=Loading, Type=Nusuk (80451:18763): One side has sent and the other is working, or something runs in the background. Nusuk: the bot at the start with the three dots beside it; User: the avatar at the end with the dots beside it; centred, Space/SM apart, no bubble.

changed.change: bot aligned to the top (was the bottom); tail corner top-start (was bottom-start).
the header row with the 12×14 mark is for answered (user) messages only. On a Nusuk message, question is the bubble's first line (Body 1), and the bot stays.

time follows the reading direction: start for Nusuk, end for the user (it was pinned left-to-right, which put both on the wrong side in Arabic). Time and question header: Notes 14 Regular (was Light).
bot or avatar and dots centred on each other (row class nkc-loading).

native.ios: Nusuk row: HStack(alignment: .top, spacing: 12) { bot; bubble }; bubble UnevenRoundedRectangle(topLeading: 8, others 18). User row: VStack(spacing: 18) { question header; HStack(alignment: .bottom, spacing: 12) { bubble; avatar } } with bottomTrailing 8. Footer time .leading for Nusuk, .trailing for the user.
native.android: Nusuk row: Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.Top, horizontalArrangement = spacedBy(12.dp)); RoundedCornerShape(topStart = 8.dp, others 18.dp). User: Column(spacedBy(18.dp)) { header; Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.Bottom) }, bottomEnd = 8.dp. Time TextAlign.Start (Nusuk) / TextAlign.End (user).

breaking: Message with from: 'nusuk' and question no longer renders the header row; the question is inside the bubble.

new prop bot (default true). bot:false drops the 38 (insight) or 20 (pill) bot; the text starts at the note padding.
class nkc-thread on the thread container hides the bot on any Nusuk message or insight note followed by another Nusuk message. A user message, a sheet or the end of the thread ends the run.

native.ios: In the thread list, pass showsBot = (next item is not from Nusuk) to each Nusuk row; when false, keep a 24 pt leading spacer for bubbles, none for the insight note.
native.android: In the LazyColumn, showBot = items.getOrNull(i + 1)?.from != Nusuk; Spacer(Modifier.width(24.dp)) in its place for bubbles.
